name: Marktstand (gestreift)
look: one flat rectangular canvas awning roof with broad deep blue and white stripes running front to back, a thin wooden pole tip at each of the four corners, a narrow strip of wooden counter with rolled bolts of crimson and saffron cloth visible along the front edge

name: Marktstand (grün)
look: one flat rectangular dark green canvas awning roof with a scalloped front hem, a wooden pole tip at each corner, a narrow wooden counter along the front edge holding a tray of silver fish on white crushed ice

name: Marktstand (Plane)
look: one flat rectangular charcoal grey canvas awning roof with a wooden pole tip at each corner, a narrow wooden table along the front edge with steel swords and axes laid parallel and a round wooden shield

name: Marktstand (Fleisch)
look: one flat rectangular dark red canvas awning roof with a wooden pole tip at each corner, a narrow thick wooden butcher block along the front edge with hams, sausages and a cleaver

name: Planwagen
en: covered wagon roof seen from above
look: one long rounded rectangle of off-white canvas stretched over wooden hoops forming the wagon cover, four spoked wooden wheels peeking out at the four corners, a single long wooden shaft pointing forward from the front

name: Heuhaufen
look: one rounded dome of golden dry hay, a dense even surface of hay strands, slightly brighter at the top, soft irregular round outline

name: Strohballen
look: exactly three rectangular golden straw bales lying side by side in one row, each tied with two strands of twine, nothing else

name: Brennholzstapel
look: one long pile of bark-covered logs lying side by side, their lengths parallel, the rough brown bark tops visible from above, pale split faces in between

name: Amboss
en: blacksmith anvil on a tree stump
look: exactly one black iron anvil: its flat polished steel face and pointed horn, resting on a round wooden stump that shows its growth rings around the anvil, nothing else

name: Schmiedeesse
look: one square hearth built of rough grey stones with a thick soot-blackened rim, a sunken bed of glowing orange and red coals in the middle, a brown leather bellows lying against one side

name: Denkmal
en: statue on a square stone plinth
look: one square grey stone plinth with stepped edges seen from directly above, on its centre the top of a bronze statue: helmet, shoulders and an outstretched sword arm, green patina on the bronze

name: Laternenpfahl
en: iron street lantern cap seen from above
look: the square black iron pyramid cap of one street lantern seen from directly above, warm golden light glowing out around its four edges, a small round post base below

name: Bienenstöcke
look: exactly three round domed straw bee skeps in a row on one wooden plank, their coiled straw spirals clearly visible from above, nothing else

name: Hühnerstall
en: chicken coop roof and run seen from above
look: the flat sloped wooden plank roof of one small chicken coop on the left and a small square fenced run of woven willow on the right with three white hens, strictly from above so that no walls are visible

name: Grab mit Grabstein
look: one long narrow mound of dark earth covered with short grass, a small weathered grey headstone at the top end, a few small wild flowers

name: Wasserrad
en: mill water wheel seen from above
look: a long narrow rectangle made of many parallel wooden paddle boards between two thin wooden rims, a thick wooden axle crossing the middle, white water splashing along both long sides

name: Fischernetz
en: fishing net spread flat on the ground
look: one large brown knotted fishing net spread completely flat in a rough rectangle, round cork floats along one edge, a coil of rope in a corner

name: Glockenturm (Dach)
look: one square pyramid roof seen from directly above: four triangular faces of grey slate tiles meeting in the exact centre at a small iron finial, a square stone parapet rim around it

name: Gemüsefeld
look: straight parallel rows of bright green cabbages and leafy crops with strips of dark brown soil between them, strong contrast, uniform cover
